generic_sampling_rules.int_pk: Sequential integers starting at 1, unique per table; never NULL; generated PKs are disjoint from compact PKs (start above max compact PK).
generic_sampling_rules.int_fk: Sample from the union of compact parent PKs and generated parent PKs; the FK column is NOT NULL unless declared nullable; never plant NULL in a NOT NULL / primary-key FK column.
generic_sampling_rules.int_quantity: Positive integers in a small range (1-50); never NULL when NOT NULL.
generic_sampling_rules.text_short: Draw from a small pool of realistic short strings; allow case/spacing/punctuation near-variants; NULL only where the column is nullable.
generic_sampling_rules.text_name: Draw from a pool of person-like names; enforce a 20-50% duplicate share across DISTINCT queries; NULL only where nullable.
generic_sampling_rules.text_nationality: Draw from a small enum-like pool of country names; enforce a 20-50% duplicate share; NULL only where nullable.
generic_sampling_rules.text_year: Four-digit year strings in 1990-2020; duplicates allowed; NULL only where nullable.
generic_sampling_rules.bool_flag: Sample from {0,1} (or 'T'/'F' text form); occasional NULL only where nullable.
generic_sampling_rules.boundary_numeric: For numeric columns with comparison targets, include every listed literal and one step on each side (e.g. 34,35,36,44,45,46 for age boundaries); these boundary literals are non-NULL and must survive NULL planting; if the target row count is smaller than the boundary set, raise the row count (never truncate the boundary set).
generic_sampling_rules.tie_order: For ORDER/COUNT columns, ensure at least two rows share the top count value so rank-1 ties occur in both ASC and DESC directions; a tie at rank 'any (no LIMIT)' is satisfied trivially by returning all rows.
generic_sampling_rules.null_share: For every nullable column, each instance contains at least one NULL row and a NULL share following the compact database's observed share; where the compact share is 0.0, use a uniform fallback NULL_SHARE = 0.10 (5-10% band) for all nullable columns; NOT NULL and primary-key columns never receive NULL; one planted NULL is never replaced to satisfy another rule.
generic_sampling_rules.composite_pk: Draw composite primary-key tuples without replacement from the cross product of parent PK pools; if the cross product is smaller than the target child row count, raise the parent table sizes (or reduce the child count) so the cross product is large enough; assert len(set(pairs)) == n and the final child row count equals the target size before writing; no duplicate-producing fallback.
generic_sampling_rules.childless_parent_verify: Operate on the union of compact+generated parent PKs and the union of compact+generated referenced PKs (compact party_host rows count as references). Reserve a parent PK that is not already referenced by any compact or generated child row; if no such PK exists, generate an extra parent row (raise table size) so a childless parent is guaranteed. Assert before writing that each referenced parent table has at least one unreferenced PK.

targets.note: boundary literals must be present as non-NULL values; plant NULLs only on non-boundary positions; assert all six appear in final non-NULL Age values; choose_table_sizes must guarantee host size >= 6 (TABLE_SIZES['host'] - 2 >= len(AGE_BOUNDARY))

targets.tie_at_rank: any (no LIMIT) — trivially satisfied, all rows returned

targets.qualifying_rows: per group, ensure at least 2 rows carry different non-NULL Number_of_hosts values; NULLs, where allowed, are excluded from this comparison

dependencies.rule: composite PK; each (Party_ID, Host_ID) pair unique; draw pairs without replacement from the cross product of the union of compact+generated parent PK pools so exactly n unique rows are produced; assert len(set(pairs)) == n and final row count == target before writing; if cross product < n, raise parent table sizes

reserve at least one parent PK (from the union of compact+generated PKs) that is not referenced by any compact or generated party_host row; if no such PK exists, generate an extra parent row (raise table size); verify after construction that host and party each contain a childless row; assert before writing

semantic_rules_and_formulas.formula: Last_year IS NULL OR First_year IS NULL OR CAST(Last_year AS INTEGER) >= CAST(First_year AS INTEGER)
semantic_rules_and_formulas.evidence: all shown rows satisfy Last_year >= First_year; rule evaluated on non-NULL operands only (SQL three-valued logic)
observed 4-31; NULL permitted by schema and excluded from comparison rules

semantic_rules_and_formulas.formula: Is_Main_in_Charge IS NULL OR Is_Main_in_Charge IN (0, 1)
